overview:
Kumaon's quiet high country from Delhi: this **3 Nights / 4 Days** long-weekend trip takes in boho cafés at Kasar Devi, Birthi Waterfall on the road to Munsiyari and a forest trek to camp at Khaliya Top facing Panchachuli. You leave Delhi in the evening by AC Tempo Traveller or bus and travel overnight to Almora.

Day 1 is Kasar Devi: the temple, a village walk, café hopping and a Kumaon sunset. Day 2 drives to Munsiyari via Bageshwar, Sama Village and the 126 m Birthi Waterfall. Day 3 is the 5 km trek from Balati Bend to Khaliya Top, with an optional hike to Zero Point for views of Panchachuli, Nanda Kot and Rajrambha and a night in forest huts or tents. Day 4 is sunrise, the trek down and the drive back, reaching Delhi late at night or early on Day 5. Prices start at ₹9,000 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.title: Delhi to Almora
itinerary.content:
Assemble at the pickup point in Delhi in the evening and meet your team captain and the group.
Overnight journey by AC Tempo Traveller or bus.
Halt for dinner on the way (not included).

itinerary.title: Arrival at Kasar Devi
itinerary.content:
Morning arrival via Ranikhet and Almora; check in, freshen up and relax.
Afternoon at Kasar Devi Temple, on the Van Allen Belt, known for its cosmic energy.
Village walk and café hopping, with a peaceful sunset over the Kumaon valley.
Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Kasar Devi to Munsiyari
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, begin the scenic drive to Munsiyari.
On the way: Bageshwar at the confluence of the Saryu and Gomti, short halts at Sama Village, and the 126 m Birthi Waterfall.
Check in at Munsiyari and relax. Dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Khaliya Top trek | Zero Point
itinerary.content:
After breakfast, start the trek from Balati Bend: 5 km one way through forests and meadows.
Reach Khaliya Top and rest in forest huts or tents.
Optional hike on to Zero Point for views of Panchachuli, Nanda Kot and Rajrambha.
Sunset views, a warm dinner and a night under the stars.

itinerary.title: Khaliya Top to Munsiyari | Return to Delhi
itinerary.content:
Watch the sunrise over snow-capped peaks.
After breakfast, trek down to Munsiyari.
Start the return journey to Delhi by afternoon. Reach Delhi by late night or early morning.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi by AC Tempo Traveller or bus, travelling overnight via Ranikhet and Almora to Kasar Devi. The final pickup point and time are shared with confirmed travellers before the trip.

faqs.q: How much does the Kasar Devi, Munsiyari & Khaliya Top trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹9,000 per person on quad sharing, ₹9,500 on triple sharing and ₹10,000 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

Transport from Delhi to Delhi, local sightseeing, 3 nights' stay at Kasar Devi, Munsiyari and Khaliya Top, 3 breakfasts and 3 dinners, a trip captain, all permits and taxes, mechanical support, a first-aid kit and 24x7 support.

faqs.q: How long is the Khaliya Top trek?
faqs.a: 5 km one way from Balati Bend through forests and meadows. You camp at Khaliya Top on Day 3, with an optional hike on to Zero Point, and trek down on Day 4.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat with an advance of ₹3,000 per person by UPI, GPay, PhonePe, Paytm or net banking, then clear the balance 24 hours before boarding. 5% GST is extra on the trip price.
If you cancel, the ₹3,000 advance is not refunded under any circumstances. There are also no refunds for any inclusion you don't use, and bookings cannot be transferred to someone else.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack a down or main jacket, thermals, socks and gloves, good shoes, a daypack, personal medication and a small first-aid kit. The full list is under Things To Pack.
